label: automated judge, not independent review
description: Example, not configured: the optional automated whole-answer judge. Pass a copy to `evaluate --judge`. The model must differ from the generator; the harness refuses a judge whose model name or identity matches the run's model, whose endpoint is the run's own route, or whose response reports another model.
adapterNotes: openai-chat posts to any OpenAI-compatible /v1/chat/completions endpoint; anthropic-messages posts to /v1/messages with an x-api-key header.
credentialsNotes: Either env (an environment variable name) or file (a path outside the repository). Keys are never written to any record.
